# Did a dependency's license just change under you?

> Paste two snapshots of your dependency tree's declared licenses (npm, pip, cargo, go) and find out in one click which packages changed license since the last one — the change Dependabot and Renovate do not flag. Free, runs entirely in your browser, nothing is uploaded.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
